text:
Type: white ceramic plant pot
Use: holding a potted plant on a windowsill, shelf or table; living room, kitchen, bedroom, home office
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: glazed white ceramic with embossed relief patterns
Colors: glossy white
Shape: round tapered cachepot shown in four relief designs, cable-knit ovals, vertical ribs, wide horizontal bands and fine horizontal ridges, compact and tidy
Feel: fresh, clean, crafted, calm
Goes with: green plants, light wood, white walls, linen; Scandinavian, minimalist or farmhouse rooms
